Check in, with animation, sound and haptics. You can turn sound and haptics off in Settings.
Opens the check-in log: write a few lines about how it felt, tap “Full screen” to write longer on lined paper, or “Undo check-in” here.
When the card lifts, drag it to reorder or move it into another group.
Tap a group name to collapse or expand it; tap + next to it to add a card right in that group.
Tap the date at the top
Collapses or expands the week bar; the content below moves up with it.
Swipe on the date bar or check-in area to go to the previous or next day; you can check in late on any day.
When you’re not on today, “Back to today” appears at the top left.

Tap “Notes” below the date bar to write about the day in full screen. The keyboard only appears when you tap a blank area; scrolling is just for reading. The title is optional and taken from the first words.
On days with notes, note cards appear above the check-ins; tap the arrow next to “Notes” to collapse them. Tap a card to open it, tap ⋯ at the top right to delete.
See each card’s check-in time and notes for the day in time order.
